instruction.text: Drag the clauses to the correct group.

hint.text:
A main clause can be a sentence on its own. It will always have a subject and a verb.

A subordinate clause cannot be a sentence on its own. It gives extra information to a main clause.

A relative clause usually begins with a relative pronoun. It provides extra information about a noun or pronoun in a main clause.

atoms.b: Sarah went to the charity shop in town
they walked briskly through the woods
if I were better at maths
where there are lots of houses
